newsitem.title: TUNISIA: SOCCER-TUNISIA'S ETOILE SAHEL GAIN CAF FINAL FIRST LEG EDGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TUNISIA'S ETOILE SAHEL GAIN CAF FINAL FIRST LEG EDGE.

text.p: Defending champions Etoile Sahel of Tunisia gained a 3-1 advantage over Morocco's Kawkab Marrakesh in the first leg of the Confederation of African Football (CAF) final on Sunday.

Marrakesh took the lead through Aziz Zebdi in the fifth minute but Etoile Sahel, aiming to become the first team to win the tournament twice, hit back with three goals in a 12-minute spell before the interval.
Imed Ben Younes and Zoubayr Baya gave the Moroccan defence a hard time before Kais Ghodbane secured Etoile's equaliser in the 24th minute.
Etoile maintained the pressure and Lotfi Baccouche scored their second goal from the penalty spot in the 30th minute after a foul on Baya.
Riyadh Bouazizi added the third for the Tunisian league leaders six minutes later, punishing an error by Marrakesh goalkeeper Kaddour Lamrani.
Marrakesh, on the defensive after their opening goal, had to wait until the 42nd minute for their second chance but striker Mohamed Badraoui squandered the opportunity.

Marrakesh adopted a more attacking game in the second half. They succeeded in disrupting Etoile's tactics and prevented the home side from scoring any more goals but did not manage to reduce the arrears.
Etoile have won all their home games in the last two years of the competition.
The return leg will be played in Marrakesh on November 30.
